spans.text: Unforgivable... Unforgivable! I'm gonna kill you!
It wasn't me.
Shut up, liar! Get out!!
I'll kill you!!
She rejected me again. Will we get another chance?
We are running out of time, Master.
The Military has already reached the designated location.
All our preparations are in place. May we initiate the final plan?
Why...
What on earth happened...?
I can't hear her anymore...
Due to the humans' interference, all connections have been severed.
She made her choice. Now you must make yours.
Don't worry. I will keep an eye on her.
But for you...time is running short...
...Elisa.
I understand.
It's a shame, but let's do it.
Agent, unleash the full power of Parapluie.
...Meanwhile, at the Military's temporary command center.
It's begun... Finally, it's begun!
Sangvis Ferri is fully activating Parapluie. Let us spice up their show.
Carter, what's the status of your forces?
Our human troops have already retreated. The mechanical units are all left behind along the defense line as planned.
The active defense system on Level II is deactivated while the connection to the main server is open.
Good. Very good.
Are you sure Mastermind is capable of acquiring what we want her to get?
What are you talking about?
This is the Parapluie virus that we pride ourselves on. Our lovely lady can do whatever she pleases with it.
I look forward to it, though it's ironic how we are staking the future of the country on these T-Dolls...
A long time ago, our nice, peaceful world was destroyed because of several kids.
Isn't this what you'd call "fate"? It's interesting precisely because it's unpredictable.
Speaking of which, I'm quite surprised a small company like Griffin ended up playing such an important role.
Though their part is coming to an end.
...Carter bows his head and chuckles.
Kryuger, I'll save the apology for when next we meet. You'll probably be in prison by then.
...Meanwhile, Griffin Control.
Commander, this is a super emergency!
Some of our T-Dolls have suddenly stopped receiving orders and started attacking our logistic facilities!
The situation is temporarily under control, but according to various reports, we are also under the attack of multiple military units!
...Click. Click.
Commander, our...mand system is suffering...large-scale attack...
(Static)
...almost completely paralyzed...
(Static)
...guess...infected by a more potent version of the Parapluie virus!
Commander, your forces are within the coverage...
Take all uninfected T-Dolls with you and withdraw this instant!
Commander, what about M4 and the others?!
Their location is completely overrun by Parapluie... Our T-Dolls would lose their mind the moment they set foot in there!
Even the AR Team and the Carcano sisters could already be...
And there's nothing we can do...
Why... How did this happen...? We even promised them...
...Click.
Griffin Commander.
Do you trust me?
Don't try to track my signal. This isn't the time for that. At the very least, I'm not your enemy.
If you trust me just as Persica does...
...give me M4A1's coordinates.
...I can't guarantee anything. All I can do is to make up for what I did before.
No need to thank me. I'm getting paid for this.
You fought well today, but the AR Team aren't your only subordinates.
Protect all the T-Dolls that you can and leave the rest to me. Best of luck to the both of us.
Attention, all Griffin personnel in Area S11! Attention, all Griffin personnel in Area S11!
There has been a contingency in Area S09. The area is in total disarray!
We are currently coordinating a large-scale withdrawal from the area, and our retreating forces will be passing through Area S11!
All commanders on standby, please report immediately to your command center!
All Griffin personnel in Area S11 are to prepare for battle. Repel the Sangvis assault and protect as many of our troops as you can!
Attention, all Griffin personnel in Area S11! Attention, all Griffin personnel in Area S11!
Battle stations! Repel the Sangvis assault and protect as many of our troops as you can!
We have no choice but to trust that person.
They're right, Commander, a lot of our T-Dolls are waiting for rescue!
We must keep the routes open and help them escape!
